facts.statement: Before any drafting, capture the target: model name/size, context budget, and whether reasoning is enabled.
Interview one focused question per turn until every Spec field is answered; ask clarifying questions rather than writing a plan document.
Present the filled Spec block for user sign-off before writing the prompt file; generated exemplars enter the file only after user confirmation.
The deliverable is a markdown prompt file at .dangerpowers/prompts/<task-slug>.md, echoed in chat; do not execute the task the prompts describe; verification is user sign-off, not a live model run.
Classify the task as extraction/classification, math/logic/symbolic, generation, or multi-step reasoning; the classification selects the techniques.
Decompose any task with more than 2-3 steps into a phase chain, one task per phase; never emit compound instructions - split the phase instead of strengthening the wording.
Do not apply to a frontier or hosted model target (use prompt-shaping instead), a small tweak of a working prompt (edit it directly), or a purely informational request (nothing to design).
When the output must match a format, tone, or task structure, add 1-3 drafted few-shot input/output exemplar pairs, confirmed by the user.
For math/logic/symbolic tasks, exemplars show worked chains-of-thought - the method is demonstration, not appending 'think step by step'.
Always end every prompt with a format contract - labeled output slots and a stop condition; fix format drift with slots and exemplars, not stronger wording.
Front-load every prompt - task statement first, minimal context; shared material is written once in the file's Shared context section and never repeated inside a phase.
For a high-stakes reasoning phase, add a self-consistency harness note (`<!-- harness: run 3 samples, majority-vote -->`) in the phase header.
The verification method must be mechanically checkable by a harness (regex, parse, diff, test); small models self-critique poorly.

The file opens with one-or-two-sentence run instructions for the executing agent; each phase carries Input:/Output: contracts; phase inputs stay in context in a single-session run - never add paste placeholders.

The Spec block elicits each field explicitly: Goal, In scope, Out of scope, Assumptions, Success criteria, Output format, Audience, Grounding context, Failure cases, Target model, Context budget, Decomposition plan, Exemplars, Format contract, Verification method.

excluded.reason: motivation only - 'succeeds through demonstrated pattern and narrow scope'; prescribes nothing an agent could get wrong
worked example illustrating already-kept facts; mined for query material (support-transcript scenario) instead of listed as a fact
restatement of the kept facts; adds no new testable content
remaining items are rationale clauses for kept rules (context-window cost, schema drift); the rules themselves are covered by facts 4, 8-11, and 14
